claim.statement: The cluster's own metrics cannot be scraped or remote-read by an external Prometheus; Mayo exposes no /metrics exposition endpoint, no remote-read, no remote_write and no PromQL, only /v1/metrics JSON endpoints, relish, the dashboards and SQL.

sources.quote: Mayo does not expose its data in Prometheus exposition format.
There is no `/v1/read` remote-read endpoint and no `/metrics` Prometheus-exposition endpoint.

claim.measurable: curl -k https://NODE:9117/metrics and /v1/read are not served (no Prometheus exposition or remote-read); no remote_write sender exists in the config schema; an external Prometheus cannot federate the cluster. Admitted limitation, not a defect (roadmap lists PromQL and the full metrics architecture under Later, F06
